def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db["orders"]
    items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    seed_time = pd.Timestamp(seed_time)
    past_items = items[items["ts"] < seed_time].copy()

    result_index = pd.Index(entity_ids)
    result = pd.DataFrame(index=result_index)

    zero_cols = [
        "total_items_sold", "total_orders_sold", "total_customers",
        "avg_price", "avg_freight", "min_price", "max_price", "std_price",
        "total_price", "total_revenue", "days_since_last", "span_days",
        "sales_last_30d", "orders_last_30d",
        "sales_last_60d", "orders_last_60d",
        "sales_last_90d", "orders_last_90d",
        "sales_last_180d", "orders_last_180d",
        "avg_review_score", "review_count", "bad_review_share",
        "avg_interval_days", "share_last_90", "had_sales",
        "sales_per_day", "trend_30_90", "avg_pay_value", "avg_installments",
        "share_installments", "delivered_share", "avg_delivery_delay",
        "est_vs_actual_delay",
    ]
    if len(past_items) == 0:
        for col in zero_cols:
            result[col] = 0
        return result.reindex(result_index)

    orders_sub = orders[["order_id", "customer_id",
                         "order_delivered_customer_date",
                         "order_estimated_delivery_date"]]
    merged = past_items.merge(orders_sub, on="order_id", how="left")
    merged["price_freight"] = merged["price"] + merged["freight_value"]

    # время появления записи о доставке: не позже seed_time
    delivered_mask = (merged["order_delivered_customer_date"].notna()) & \
                     (merged["order_delivered_customer_date"] <= seed_time)
    merged["delivered_known"] = delivered_mask.astype(float)
    merged["delivery_delay"] = np.where(
        delivered_mask,
        (merged["order_delivered_customer_date"] - merged["ts"]).dt.days,
        np.nan,
    )
    merged["est_vs_actual_delay"] = np.where(
        delivered_mask,
        (merged["order_delivered_customer_date"] -
         merged["order_estimated_delivery_date"]).dt.days,
        np.nan,
    )

    grp = merged.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_items_sold=("price_freight", "count"),
        total_orders_sold=("order_id", "nunique"),
        total_customers=("customer_id", "nunique"),
        avg_price=("price", "mean"),
        avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
        min_price=("price", "min"),
        max_price=("price", "max"),
        std_price=("price", "std"),
        total_price=("price", "sum"),
        total_revenue=("price_freight", "sum"),
        first_ts=("ts", "min"),
        last_ts=("ts", "max"),
        delivered_share=("delivered_known", "mean"),
        avg_delivery_delay=("delivery_delay", "mean"),
        est_vs_actual_delay=("est_vs_actual_delay", "mean"),
    )

    for window in [30, 60, 90, 180]:
        start = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=window)
        mask = (merged["ts"] >= start) & (merged["ts"] < seed_time)
        win = merged[mask]
        grp[f"sales_last_{window}d"] = win.groupby("product_id").size()
        grp[f"orders_last_{window}d"] = win.groupby("product_id")["order_id"].nunique()

    # отзывы: учитываем только те, что уже написаны до seed_time
    rev = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_time][
        ["order_id", "review_score"]]
    review_joined = past_items[["order_id", "product_id"]].merge(
        rev, on="order_id", how="inner"
    )
    if len(review_joined) > 0:
        rev_agg = review_joined.groupby("product_id").agg(
            avg_review_score=("review_score", "mean"),
            review_count=("review_score", "count"),
        )
        bad = review_joined.assign(
            bad=(review_joined["review_score"] <= 2).astype(float)
        ).groupby("product_id")["bad"].mean().rename("bad_review_share")
        rev_agg = rev_agg.join(bad)
    else:
        rev_agg = pd.DataFrame(
            columns=["avg_review_score", "review_count", "bad_review_share"]
        )
    grp = grp.join(rev_agg, how="left")

    # платежи: используем только заказы, сделанные до seed_time (ts из payments совпадает)
    pay = payments[payments["ts"] < seed_time]
    pay_agg = pay.groupby("order_id").agg(
        pay_value=("payment_value", "sum"),
        installments=("payment_installments", "max"),
    )
    pay_joined = past_items[["order_id", "product_id"]].merge(
        pay_agg, on="order_id", how="inner"
    )
    if len(pay_joined) > 0:
        pay_feats = pay_joined.groupby("product_id").agg(
            avg_pay_value=("pay_value", "mean"),
            avg_installments=("installments", "mean"),
        )
        inst_share = pay_joined.assign(
            has_inst=(pay_joined["installments"] > 1).astype(float)
        ).groupby("product_id")["has_inst"].mean().rename("share_installments")
        pay_feats = pay_feats.join(inst_share)
    else:
        pay_feats = pd.DataFrame(
            columns=["avg_pay_value", "avg_installments", "share_installments"]
        )
    grp = grp.join(pay_feats, how="left")

    grp["days_since_last"] = (seed_time - grp["last_ts"]).dt.days
    grp["span_days"] = (grp["last_ts"] - grp["first_ts"]).dt.days

    def avg_interval(s):
        s = s.drop_duplicates().sort_values()
        if len(s) < 2:
            return np.nan
        return s.diff().dropna().dt.days.mean()

    grp["avg_interval_days"] = merged.groupby("product_id")["ts"].apply(avg_interval)

    grp["sales_per_day"] = grp["total_orders_sold"] / grp["span_days"]
    grp["sales_per_day"] = grp["sales_per_day"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    grp["share_last_90"] = grp["orders_last_90d"] / grp["total_orders_sold"]
    grp["trend_30_90"] = grp["orders_last_30d"] / grp["orders_last_90d"].replace(0, np.nan)

    result = grp.reindex(result_index)
    result["had_sales"] = result["total_orders_sold"].fillna(0) > 0
    # нейтральное значение для отсутствующих отзывов
    result["avg_review_score"] = result["avg_review_score"].fillna(3.0)
    result = result.fillna(0)
    result = result.reindex(result_index)

    return result
